answers.reason: The faculty administrative officer only takes part where their own faculty matters are decided.

The appointment committee handles professorship appointments, which is outside the faculty administrative officer's designated body.
The faculty administrative officer organizes examinations and records for the faculty and takes part in its governing body.
The study commission is for degree programmes and teaching, not the administrative officer's specific body.
The examination board handles individual student examination matters, which is separate from the faculty administrative officer's duties.
The internal research funding round awards grants, which does not concern the faculty administrative officer.
The module revision working group rewrites module descriptions, which is not the faculty administrative officer's body.
Laboratory equipment procurement chooses equipment, which is outside the faculty administrative officer's duties.
Orientation week planning is for new students, which is not the faculty administrative officer's designated place.
